title: Rig Work Task
description: ADR implementation task file. Contains one or more sprints with mandatory research and optional flat missions. No recursive subtasks. A large ADR may have multiple sprints. See docs/workflow/adr-sprint-mission-evidence.md for the canonical workflow narrative: ADR → Sprint → Sprint Research → Mission → Patch Batch → Evidence → Review/Promotion.

id.description: Stable slug matching the ADR workspace directory name.

adr.description: Repo-relative path to the ADR markdown file.

allowed_paths.description: Glob patterns bounding all sprint and mission authority. Sprints and missions may only narrow this set.

protected_paths.description: Paths agents must never modify or claim.

required_checks.description: CLI commands that must pass before promoting.

sprints.description: List of sprints for this ADR. A massive ADR may have multiple sprints. Each sprint must have completed research before implementation.

must_stop_if.description: Conditions that must halt execution immediately, e.g., 'protected_paths_touched', 'unexpected_dirty_files'.

id.description: Unique mission identifier within the sprint.

allowed_paths.description: Must be a subset of parent sprint allowed_paths, which must be a subset of task allowed_paths.

patch_batches.description: Patch batches applied during this mission. Missions should be executed as patch batches where practical.

patch_batch.description: A coherent set of related changes applied together. Must be prechecked and validated.

id.description: Unique batch identifier within the mission.

precheck_passed.description: Whether git apply --check passed before applying.

precheck_command.description: The git apply --check command that was run.

apply_command.description: The git apply command used to apply the patch.

patch_file.description: Path to the unified diff patch file under .rig/work/adr/<adr-id>/sprints/<sprint-id>/patch-batches/

planned_files.description: Files expected to be changed by this batch. Stop if actual files exceed this.

actual_files.description: Files actually changed by this batch. Must match or be subset of planned_files.

protected_paths_touched.description: Any protected paths that were touched. Must be empty or block application.

validation_results.description: Results of validation after applying the batch.

applied_at.description: When the patch batch was applied.

validated_at.description: When the patch batch was validated.

sprint.description: A scope-bounded implementation campaign. Must have completed research before implementation. A large ADR may have multiple sprints.

id.description: Unique sprint identifier within the ADR.

research_status.description: Sprint Research is mandatory. Implementation cannot begin until research_status is 'completed'.

allowed_paths.description: Glob patterns bounding sprint authority. Must be a subset of task allowed_paths. Missions may only narrow this further.

mission_ids.description: List of mission IDs in this sprint. Alternatively, use inline missions.

missions.description: Inline mission definitions for this sprint. Alternative to mission_ids.

patch_batch_plan.description: Planned patch batches for this sprint. Defined during research phase.

validation_plan.description: Validation commands that must pass. Defined during research phase.
